title: Service Credit Percentages and Claim Windows for the Corporate Catering Service Agreement
content:
Four figures are printed against each service level of the Corporate Catering Service Agreement for credits allowed against an order.

1. **Late delivery credit** — the credit for each quarter hour a delivery arrives late, as a percentage of order value.
2. **Credit ceiling** — the ceiling on the credits allowed against one order, as a percentage of order value.
3. **Claim window** — the calendar days after the order was delivered within which a credit claim is accepted.
4. **Quality credit** — the credit allowed for an upheld food quality complaint, as a percentage of order value.

| Service level | Late delivery credit per quarter hour | Credit ceiling | Claim window | Quality credit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Drop-Off Catering Account | 2.0 per cent | 20.0 per cent | 7 days | 10.0 per cent |
| Delivered Buffet Account | 2.5 per cent | 25.0 per cent | 10 days | 12.5 per cent |
| Attended Buffet Account | 3.0 per cent | 30.0 per cent | 14 days | 15.0 per cent |
| Staffed Full-Service Catering Account | 4.0 per cent | 40.0 per cent | 21 days | 20.0 per cent |
| Executive Hospitality Catering Account | 5.0 per cent | 50.0 per cent | 30 days | 25.0 per cent |
| Campus Catering Master Account | 3.5 per cent | 35.0 per cent | 21 days | 18.0 per cent |

The Executive Hospitality Catering Account carries the widest figures in the schedule — 5.0 per cent a quarter hour, a ceiling of 50.0 per cent and a claim window of 30 days — even though it is not the largest service level by guest count; the Campus Catering Master Account sits below it at 3.5 per cent, a ceiling of 35.0 per cent and a window of 21 days.
